title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-29 07:21:20 最新章节：第4937章 百万年无敌的宗门在叶炎面前只能如此了吗
content_zh:
炎界，南域，万炎帝国，苍云城！
叶家床榻之上，一少年脸色苍白，如今的他经脉骨骼尽断，气息奄奄，所有人都断定他活不成了！
但就在此时，少年的手指微微一动，随后眼眸便是彻底睁开。
“我……我还活着！”叶炎缓缓开口道。
随后他拳头紧握，几乎是从牙齿内渗出了这两个名字：“云飞雪！云飞月！”
三日前的一切，他此生都不会忘记。
那一日本该是叶炎与云飞月订婚之日。
但，云家却强势而来。
云飞月的亲姐姐云飞雪更是凌驾于叶家的半空之上，将圣人之威爆发。
圣人境，整个万炎帝国千年历史内，也只有寥寥几位而已，至于云飞雪这等二十岁的女圣人，乃是唯一！
云飞雪仗着这等力量，要在全城目光之下逼迫叶炎毁掉婚书，承认此婚约乃是叶啸天伪造！
叶炎此生最为敬仰之人，便是父亲叶啸天。
他怎会承认？
即便圣威在上，他依旧傲然而立，绝不屈服。
云飞雪大怒直接震碎了叶炎的经脉骨骼，要让叶炎成为一世废人。
至今，他都记得当时云飞雪对他所言之语：“圣人为天，凡人为狗！叶炎，你在我眼中，犹如草芥。如你这般人物，也敢违抗我的圣命？岂不知这是螳臂当车、不自量力！在我与云家眼中，你不过是蝼蚁而已！”
而后，叶炎的未婚妻云飞月更是出现在云飞雪的身边，她紫色衣衫在身，高贵无比，以着俯视苍生的眼眸，带着深深的不屑对叶炎道：“你叶炎，永远也配不上我，我已觉醒圣体即将进入云朝宗，云朝宗可是南域境内的圣宗，而你……不过是凡人而已。圣凡两别，你我终究不是一个世界！”
“我云飞月将来的丈夫，乃是世间天才！”
“可你在我眼中……只是凡界的一条狗而已！”
这声音响彻苍云城！

这是将叶炎一生所有的尊严不留余地的彻底践踏！
但，叶炎不服！
这婚约明明是当初云家弱小时，求着叶家订下！若和平解约也就罢了，为何云家竟是如此羞辱叶家？
但云飞雪已是悍然出手，圣威下，将叶炎彻底镇压。此等威能，即便是叶家的修炼者也无法抗衡。但那一刻，叶炎手中之剑，却闪过一道光泽，护住了叶炎。
这把剑，乃是当初父亲叶啸天手中之剑。也是叶啸天留给叶炎唯一的遗物，这些年来叶炎一直珍若生命，剑从不离身。
但云飞雪却冷嗤一声：“灵剑而已，今日我便让你清楚，圣人眼中一切皆为凡，此剑也是如此！”
话语落下，她直接圣力向着此剑落下。
在如此之力下，这把剑也随之嗡鸣起来，有悲怆之声响起。
叶炎永记得那一幕，心如刀割。
此剑可是父亲给他的唯一遗物，更承载着他对父亲仅存的记忆，剑在……父亲便在。
只是云飞雪那一力下，此剑彻底崩碎。
“一把破剑，竟当做宝物？蝼蚁果然是蝼蚁！”云飞月望着叶炎那悲伤之色，更是嘲讽一声。
叶家大长老无奈，只能将婚书拿出，而后云飞雪、云飞月姐妹将婚书毁掉，方才作罢，傲然离开。
至今，叶炎仍记得她们当时那高傲的姿态。
这一刻，叶炎拳头紧握，指甲都嵌入肉里。
云家，当真是欺人太甚！
只因自己乃是凡人，只因叶家不再如云家，便可欺辱他，羞辱他父亲乃至整个叶家？
一世为人，怎会一直平庸？
即便生如蝼蚁也当立鸿鹄之志，纵命薄如纸也有不屈之心！
何况，他叶炎从不信命。

而且，他也绝不是普通的凡人。当年他出生之时，便身怀帝体。
与帝体相比，云飞月如今十六岁方才觉醒圣体又算什么？
帝体，乃是世间最强体质，更凌驾于圣体之上。
只是叶啸天怕此等体质给叶炎带来杀身之祸，方才用一剑将其封印，使叶炎看上去宛如凡人一般。
如今，剑已断。
content_en:
Flame Realm, Southern Territory, Ten Thousand Flames Empire, Cangyun City!
On the bed of the Ye family, a young man looked pale. Now his meridians and bones were broken, and he was dying. Everyone concluded that he would not survive!
But at this moment, the young man's fingers moved slightly, and then his eyes opened completely.
"I...I'm still alive!" Ye Yan said slowly.
Then he clenched his fists, and these two names almost oozed out from his teeth: "Yun Feixue! Yun Feiyue!"
He will never forget what happened three days ago in this life.
That day was supposed to be the engagement day between Ye Yan and Yun Feiyue.
However, the Yun family came in force.
Yun Feiyue's biological sister Yun Feixue even towered over the Ye family in mid-air, erupting with the power of a saint.
There are only a few saints in the entire thousand-year history of the Wanyan Empire. As for Yun Feixue, a twenty-year-old female saint, she is the only one!
Relying on this power, Yun Feixue wanted to force Ye Yan to destroy the marriage contract under the eyes of the whole city and admit that the marriage contract was forged by Ye Xiaotian!
The person Ye Yan admires most in his life is his father Ye Xiaotian.
How could he admit it?
Even if the Holy Power is on top, he still stands proudly and will never give in.
Yun Feixue was furious and directly shattered Ye Yan's meridians and bones, making Ye Yan a cripple for the rest of his life.
To this day, he still remembers what Yun Feixue said to him at that time: "Saints are like heaven, mortals are like dogs! Ye Yan, in my eyes, you are like a piece of grass. How dare a person like you to disobey my holy order? Don't you know that this is a mantis trying to overestimate his capabilities! In the eyes of me and the Yun family, you are nothing more than an ant!"
Then, Ye Yan's fiancée Yun Feiyue appeared next to Yun Feixue. She was wearing purple clothes and was extremely noble. With eyes that looked down on the common people, she said to Ye Yan with deep disdain: "You, Ye Yan, will never be worthy of me. I have awakened the Holy Body and am about to enter the Yun Chao Sect. The Yun Chao Sect is the Holy Sect in the Southern Territory, and you... are just a mortal. After all, we are different from the saints and mortals. You and I are not the same world!"
"My future husband, Yun Feiyue, will be a genius in the world!"
"But in my eyes... you are just a dog in the mortal world!"
This sound resounded throughout Cangyun City!
This is a complete trampling of Ye Yan's life's dignity without leaving any room!
However, Ye Yan refused to accept it!
This engagement was clearly made when the Yun family was young and begged the Ye family! If the contract was terminated peacefully, why would the Yun family humiliate the Ye family so much?
But Yun Feixue had already taken action brazenly, and with the power of the Holy Spirit, she completely suppressed Ye Yan. Even the practitioners of the Ye family cannot compete with this kind of power. But at that moment, the sword in Ye Yan's hand flashed with luster, protecting Ye Yan.
This sword was the sword in the hands of his father Ye Xiaotian. It is also the only relic left by Ye Xiaotian to Ye Yan. Over the years, Ye Yan has always cherished it like his life and the sword has never left his body.
But Yun Feixue snorted coldly: "It's just a spiritual sword. Today I will let you know clearly that in the eyes of a saint, everything is ordinary, and this sword is also the same!"
As soon as she finished speaking, she directed her holy power toward the sword.
Under such power, the sword also buzzed, and a sad sound sounded.
Ye Yanyong remembered that scene, and his heart felt like a knife.
This sword is the only relic given to him by his father, and it also carries his only remaining memory of his father. Where the sword is... his father is there.
But under Yun Feixue's force, the sword completely shattered.
"A broken sword is treated as a treasure? Ants are indeed ants!" Yun Feiyue looked at Ye Yan's sad look and sneered.
The eldest elder of the Ye family had no choice but to take out the marriage document, and then sisters Yun Feixue and Yun Feiyue destroyed the marriage document before giving up and leaving proudly.
To this day, Ye Yan still remembers their proud posture at that time.
At this moment, Ye Yan clenched his fists so hard that his nails were embedded in his flesh.
The Yun family is really bullying others!
Just because he is a mortal, just because the Ye family is no longer like the Yun family, can he bully him, humiliate his father and even the entire Ye family?
One life as a human being, how can it remain mediocre?
Even if you are born like an ant, you should have the ambition to be a swan; even if your life is as thin as paper, you should have an unyielding heart!
What's more, Ye Yan never believed in fate.
Moreover, he is by no means an ordinary mortal. When he was born, he was pregnant with an imperial body.
Compared with the Emperor's body, what does Yun Feiyue have only awakened to the Holy Body at the age of sixteen?
The Imperial Body is the strongest body in the world, even superior to the Holy Body.
It was just that Ye Xiaotian was afraid that such a physique would bring death to Ye Yan, so he sealed it with a sword, making Ye Yan look like a mortal.
Now, the sword is broken.
